# infrawrench_price_change_settings (Resource)

The provider price-change watch: a daily scan that finds list-price changes on instance types the organization runs, alerts once per change, and can register an increase as expected so cost anomaly detection does not fire on the step.

A change is alerted only when it clears **both** thresholds; smaller ones are still listed in the Price catalog's Changes view.

An organization **singleton**, with no DELETE on the route: `terraform destroy` leaves the stored settings alone.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the daily scan (and so its alerts) runs for this organization.
- `min_monthly_impact_cents` (Number) Changes moving the organization's monthly cost by less than this, in cents of USD, are not alerted, 0–100000000. Ships as 1000 ($10).
- `min_percent` (Number) Changes under this percentage of the old list price are not alerted, 0–100. Ships as 1.
- `register_expected` (Boolean) Register an alerted increase as expected: a one-off anomaly suppression per affected account from the day the new price takes effect. Ships as true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id. Price change watch is an organization singleton, so this is the only value it ever takes and it is what `terraform import` addresses.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organization singleton: there is only ever one, and it has no id of its
# own, so it imports under the organization id.
terraform import infrawrench_price_change_settings.this org_01HXYZABCDEF
```
